title: POST /repair-slot
description: Contract 61. Frees an agent's turn slot that no process, launch, account recovery, terminal or Stop owns (busy with no process) and lets its queued work run. Not a Stop: nothing is interrupted and the queue's and goals' pause state is unchanged. Request body: session, reason (required), optional actor. The agent's state gains an audit row repeating its kind with detail {source: "slot_repair", repair_actor, repair_actor_verified, repair_reason, released_trace}. released_trace is empty when nothing was stale. repair_actor_verified has the same meaning as stop_actor_verified on /stop.
